description: This Java class 'SecuredFreemarker' provides security measures to prevent Freemarker template injection exploits in web applications. It includes methods to detect Freemarker interpolation patterns in request parameters, URLs, and content, and sanitizes inputs accordingly.

classes.name: SecuredFreemarker
classes.description: A utility class for detecting and sanitizing Freemarker template injections in web request data.

methods.name: containsFreemarkerInterpolation
methods.description: Checks if a URL or request contains Freemarker interpolation patterns, considering allowed URIs and request parameters.

methods.name: containsFreemarkerInterpolation
methods.description: Checks if a response or string contains Freemarker interpolation patterns, logs error, and sends HTTP 403 if detected.

methods.name: containsFreemarkerInterpolation
methods.description: Detects Freemarker template patterns within a string.

methods.name: sanitizeParameterMap
methods.description: Sanitizes a map of parameters by replacing Freemarker interpolation patterns with '##' to prevent exploits.
